passage.text: It's Saturday, and it's raining all day.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈsætərdeɪ, ənd ɪts ˈreɪnɪŋ ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: I stay home, and I feel bored and sleepy.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈsteɪ ˈhoʊm, ənd aɪ ˈfiːl ˈbɔːrd ənd ˈsliːpi.

passage.text: At three o'clock, Emma comes over.
passage.reading: ət ˈθriː əˈklɑːk, ˈɛmə ˈkʌmz ˈoʊvər.

passage.text: We watch a movie and eat ice cream.
passage.reading: wiː ˈwɑːtʃ ə ˈmuːvi ənd ˈiːt ˈaɪs ˌkriːm.
